subject: bug with character categorical vars + facet_grid + h/vline

messages.author: ecfd01ab625972da
messages.subject: bug with character categorical vars + facet_grid + h/vline
parts:
I'm trying to draw a histogram with a vertical line superimposed, and
faceted by a grouping variable. If the grouping variable is stored as
a character, then additional unwanted facets appear.

Some data:

n <- 100
dfr <- data.frame(
y = runif(n),
fac = gl(2, n, labels = letters[1:2])
)
dfr$ch <- as.character(dfr$fac)

The two plot variants:

p <- ggplot(dfr, aes(y)) +
geom_histogram() +
geom_vline(yintercept = 0.8)

p + facet_grid(fac ~ .) #ok
p + facet_grid(ch ~ .) #two extra facets created

The behaviour doesn't appear with facet_wrap.

p + facet_wrap(~ ch) #ok

Without including geom_vline (or geom_hline) the extra levels don't
appear. Swapping geom_histogram for geom_density makes no difference.

Before I submit this as a bug, please can someone replicate this, and
possibly help narrow down the cause of the problem.
